protocol.acceptance: every final representative edit-time sample is strictly below threshold
protocol.processCold: independent direct-spawn Bun process; no warmup/discard or selective retries
protocol.osFileCache: not flushed; fixture/index preparation, metadata hashing and preflight reads can warm OS file cache
protocol.timing: direct spawn through process exit and stdout/stderr drain; Bun startup, CLI module loading/transpilation, native loading, Git/CodeGraph child work and JSON output are included
protocol.excluded: manager startup, fixture/index preparation, byte snapshots, preflight evidence capture and manager JSON parsing
protocol.noWrite: fresh recursive enumeration of complete fixture (including Git metadata, ignored/untracked paths and empty directories) and complete runtime state; bytes/modes/link targets compared. Only CodeGraph SQLite SHM content lock/read marks are excluded; its path/type/mode still compared. Timestamps are not logical-content evidence. Test output is outside both roots.
protocol.discoveryLimit: call-local reuse is not an atomic snapshot and does not fix edits during the invocation
